newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 6.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Socialist party leader Lionel Jospin criticises French intervention yesterday in Central African Republic capital Bangui against army mutineers after the killing of two French mediator officers.
-- Bank Paribas may strengthen its investment banking activity, expects to post a return to profit in 1996 to offset a loss of four billion francs in 1995.

-- Axa chairman Claude Bebear expects shares in Paribas to rise with proof in 1997 of return to improved and sustainable results. Bebear also said to have no plans to cut 10.7 percent stake in Paribas.
